claims.statement: Vappower IMR26650 4200mAh is documented as a green, unprotected raised/button-top cell; historical test discussion reports approximately 67.2 mm length, longer than a bare 26650.
Steam Engine preserves Vappower IMR 26650 4200mAh 40A as a 4200mAh preset with a 40A runtime rating.

The Vappower IMR 26650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Vappower IMR 26650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-07-31 or earlier.
